claim: CategoryRepository.delete() is dead code and should be removed
rationale: Not dead: it is directly exercised by tests/features/categories/test_categories.py (test at ~line 94) and kept for API symmetry with the other repos. CategoryService.delete_category deliberately bypasses it with an inline commit-free DELETE because repo.delete() commits, which would end the service-owned transaction early and break the INV-7 delete-cascade atomicity (pinned by the INV-7 rollback test). The method is intentional, tested, and must not be removed. Two independent review lanes flagged it as 'dead in the service layer'; that is accurate but the 'remove it' conclusion is wrong.

rationale: Detector greps the literal hyphenated token "INV-N" in test_*.py of the SAME directory. This project tags invariants four other ways, all of which the grep misses: (1) inside the test function name with the hyphen dropped — test_INV8a_..., test_INV2c_... (the dominant convention); (2) in section-banner comments — "# Bounds (INV-14)"; (3) with sub-letters in inline comments — "# INV-12(a)"; (4) by ticket id where the INV title names it — test_FIBR0151_.... Separately, several specs deliberately RELOCATE an invariant to a sibling suite and say so in prose (reporting INV-2 -> settings suite; statements INV-13/13a -> migration suites; settings INV-10 / theme INV-13 / transfers INV-11 / category_library INV-11 / categorisation INV-16 -> shared source-scans), and db_performance "INV-5" is not a declaration at all but a cross-reference to FIBR-0005 INV-5 inside INV-3's prose. claim: ROADMAP.md:2011 (FIBR-0069) names a _signed_balance_from_tokens helper and :2006 (FIBR-0068) claims _set_combo was promoted to a shared UI util — neither symbol exists as described
rationale: Both are the bullet HEADLINE, which by this project's roadmap-format records the work as ORIGINALLY PROPOSED. In both cases the Resolved body immediately below documents the deviation explicitly and correctly. FIBR-0069 body: "Named _signed_balance (a single token) rather than the tentative _signed_balance_from_tokens, since every site passes one token" — and src/finbreak/importers/standard_bank.py:191 defines _signed_balance. FIBR-0068 body: "IMPORTANT distinction surfaced, not forced: kept DISTINCT from ImportWizardWidget._set_combo, which is UNGUARDED by design ... Merging them would have been a silent behavior change" — and src/finbreak/ui/_widgets.py:6-9 repeats that rationale in the module docstring, with select_combo_data at :27. A reviewer reading headline-only sees drift; reading the bullet sees an accurate, self-documenting record.
